text:
jason-li: Hi people-ops — quick question: Im planning to be in Portugal (Lisbon) for ~4 months this fall to support a partner. I want to stay on Redwood payroll and benefits. Do I need to change homebase or will payroll remain US? Any impact to WFH stipend or taxes?

people-ops: Short answer: likely need a review. Portugal stays >90 days become higher risk. Please fill the Temporary Remote Work (Cross-Border) form with exact dates, full address, and local working hours.

jason-li: Filed the form and included manager approval.

maria-payroll: Payroll note: For stays under 183 days we sometimes keep US payroll, but Portugal has specific social security and tax rules. If payroll stays US, well check withholding obligations and potential employer reporting. If local payroll is required, well share impacts on net pay. Typical triage 3 business days.

jason-li: What about WFH stipend? I get the US monthly allowance.

people-ops: If payroll and homebase remain US, stipend usually continues (prorated by month). If we move you to local payroll or change homebase, stipend treatment may change; well confirm in the triage.

tax-ops-bot: Automated: attach local timezone schedule and confirm no local client work. This helps assess PE risk.

jason-li: No local clients, internal-only. Schedule attached in form.

it-ops: IT note: enable VPN and update 2FA devices before travel. If you need a power adapter or to ship equipment, open an IT ticket with address and dates. International shipping can take 1-2 weeks.

benefits-team: Benefits note: Typically US medical continues for short-term travel, but check coverage for international claims. If there is a gap risk we can suggest temporary international medical insurance.

maria-payroll: Well run a short risk assessment and reply here within 3 business days. If local counsel is needed well loop legal.

jason-li: Thanks — appreciate the guidance. Ill wait for the triage update.

people-ops: Thanks Jason. Well follow up in this thread and confirm stipend/benefits once payroll finishes review.
